name: wallet-signatur-poc
description: PoC: E-Government-Antrag mit qualifizierter Signatur über die EUDI Wallet (OpenID4VP, CSC API 2.0)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "API_PORT=3001 tsx watch server/src/index.ts" "vite --port 5173 --strictPort"
scripts.bundle: npm run build && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --exclude node_modules --exclude .data --exclude .claude --exclude .DS_Store --exclude '*.tar.gz' --exclude deploy/eu-launchpad --exclude deploy/LOCAL.md -czf wallet-demo.tar.gz package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts tailwind.config.js server web docs deploy scripts README.md
